Mode: Deformation type. twist: rotate around Axis by an angle growing along it. bend: bend along Axis. noise: displace the surface with noise. round: inflate (rounds edges). onion: hollow shell.
Amount: Strength: twist/bend rate (radians per world unit), noise displacement size, round radius, or onion shell thickness, depending on Mode.
Axis: Axis used by twist and bend (x, y or z). Ignored by the other modes.
Frequency: Noise mode only: spatial frequency of the noise. Higher = finer detail.
Noiseoffset: Noise mode only: XYZ pan of the noise field. Animate it to make the surface flow.
